component.name: Stintory
component.summary: Record and compare your sim racing laps

description.p: Stintory records every session and lap while you drive and lets you review and compare them: traces over distance, a time delta, a track map and corner by corner insights. Your laps stay on your computer, with optional sync to a server you host yourself.
Supported games: iRacing (import of .ibt files), F1 25 and Le Mans Ultimate (in Proton through the Proton bridge).
